```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
snapshot_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)
snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

fetch_imdb_snapshot <- function(address, snapshot_year) {
  page <- request(address) |>
    req_timeout(120) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_html()

  table <- page |>
    html_table() |>
    pluck(1) |>
    select(`Rank & Title`, `IMDb Rating`)

  rating_tooltips <- page |>
    html_elements("td.ratingColumn strong") |>
    html_attr("title")

  table |>
    mutate(rank_title = str_squish(`Rank & Title`)) |>
    separate_wider_regex(
      rank_title,
      patterns = c(
        rank = "\\d+",
        "\\.\\s+",
        title = ".+",
        "\\s+\\(",
        year = "\\d{4}",
        "\\)"
      )
    ) |>
    mutate(
      snap_year = snapshot_year,
      rank = as.integer(rank),
      year = as.integer(year),
      rating = `IMDb Rating`,
      number = str_match(rating_tooltips, "based on ([0-9,]+) votes")[, 2] |>
        str_remove_all(",") |>
        as.numeric()
    ) |>
    select(snap_year, rank, title, year, rating, number)
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2_dfr(
  snapshot_urls,
  snapshot_years,
  fetch_imdb_snapshot
)
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(title, year),
    names_from = snap_year,
    values_from = rank
  ) |>
  drop_na(`2015`, `2022`) |>
  mutate(
    rank_change = abs(`2022` - `2015`),
    release_decade = (year %/% 10) * 10
  )

rank_changes |>
  arrange(desc(rank_change)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(avg_rank_change = mean(rank_change), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(release_decade) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
film_snapshot_counts <- imdb_snapshots |>
  group_by(title, year) |>
  summarize(snapshots = n_distinct(snap_year), .groups = "drop")

film_snapshot_counts |>
  count(snapshots, name = "films") |>
  print()
```

```{r}
decade_rank_changes <- rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(
    avg_rank_change = mean(`2022` - `2015`),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(avg_rank_change > 0, "Rank rose", "Rank fell")
  )

ggplot(
  decade_rank_changes,
  aes(
    x = avg_rank_change,
    y = factor(release_decade),
    fill = direction
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Rank direction",
    values = c("Rank fell" = "#0072B2", "Rank rose" = "#D55E00")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average IMDb Rank Change by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Change is 2022 rank minus 2015 rank; positive values mean the rank number rose.",
    x = "Average rank change (2022 rank - 2015 rank)",
    y = "Release decade",
    caption = "Sample size: 190 films appear in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  )
```
